title: Phase 122 publishes the Verification Playbook Library
summary: Thirty procedural records turn the eight conversion stages, twelve claim types, and ten quality dimensions into direct-evidence tests, rejection checks, worked examples, stop rules, and correction paths.
evidence_note: The library applies Phase 116 contracts to existing Published signal examples. It creates no source, signal, gate decision, receipt, observation, outcome, score, ranking, or automatic publication authority.
publication_effect: Adds thirty procedural method records, one hub, thirty leaf pages, and one public data export without changing upstream evidence state.
